This licence covers rgb_blink.bin, a test fixture only: the IDE's release
build never carries it.

It is tinyVision.ai's pico-ice-sdk examples/rp2_cram/rgb_blink.bin, byte for
byte (git blob 36790693d4124d880beac22451fa1d1178d2204b at commit
f3ddedcdabdbb929939720df0856f2f6b39962fc, main as of 2026-03-06; the same blob
has been in the SDK since cf3f2aefb724, 2023-02-14, then under
examples/pico_cram/), and the image the pico2-ice's FPGA flash ships with.
fpga_bitstream.rs tests that the factory-image warning recognises it.
